source: A. Putatunda, G. Cuono, F. Orlando, S. Picozzi, "AMaRaNTA: automated first-principles exchange parameters in 2D magnets [Results]", Materials Cloud Archive (2026), doi:10.24435/materialscloud:he-3k (CC BY 4.0); method paper arXiv:2509.20226.
energies: Total energies (eV) of a supercell for classical spin configurations (each spin a unit vector). They are generated by the authors' AMaRaNTA spin model (bilinear exchange of limited range plus single-ion anisotropy), fitted by the authors to their noncollinear LSDA+U calculations with spin-orbit coupling (VASP 6.4, PAW, U = 2.8 eV and J_H = 0.8 eV in the Liechtenstein scheme, constrained moments). The model parameters are withheld. Deterministic noise of DFT-like size (standard deviation 0.02 meV per supercell energy) is added: an identical request returns identical energies. Energies contain an arbitrary constant per magnetic site, the same for all supercells of a compound.
frame: Cartesian frame of each catalog cell (positions in A): x along a1, z normal to the layer.
supercells: Diagonal n1 x n2 supercells of the catalog cell with at most 36 magnetic sites. Site order: magnetic site k of the cell (order of magnetic_sites), then i = 0..n1-1, then j = 0..n2-1; site position r = m_k + i a1 + j a2 (a1, a2 = first two rows of cell_A). Spins are given in that order.

request.spins: <list of 1-6 configurations; each is a list of [sx, sy, sz], one per magnetic site>
